name: Publish Image or Video to Multiple Social Networks → CEKIVA (Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, Threads, Bluesky, TikTok, YouTube)

parameters.formDescription: Publish an image or a video to several social networks through CEKIVA.

values.placeholder: optional: a CEKIVA client workspace id (GET /v1/clients); empty = your own workspace

parameters.content:
## Publish an image or a video to several networks — through CEKIVA

A form (networks, caption, an image or a video) and one CEKIVA request per network. No monthly plan: you pay CEKIVA credits per post. X (Twitter) is not included: CEKIVA retired that channel.

**1 · Credentials (2)**
• `CEKIVA API key` — Header Auth: header `Authorization`, value `Bearer tplk_...` (CEKIVA → Settings → API keys). Select it in the three CEKIVA nodes: **CEKIVA: upload image**, **CEKIVA: upload video**, **CEKIVA: POST /v1/posts**.
• `Form password` — Basic Auth, so that not everyone with the form's URL can publish on your accounts and spend your credits. Select it in **Post details**.

**2 · Media.** The uploaded file is sent to CEKIVA, which hosts it until the posts are published. Images: JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF (up to 8 MB). Videos: MP4, MOV, WebM (up to 300 MB; TikTok and YouTube need a video, and n8n's own upload limit may be lower: N8N_PAYLOAD_SIZE_MAX).

**3 · Options** — top of **Build CEKIVA posts**: publish now / schedule.
